_note: Every dataset the app ships must be listed here with its licence. build-packs fails if a pack has no entry. 'origin' records where the file in data/raw came from; v16 snapshot files were not recorded with their upstream file, so Phase 2 replaces them with pinned upstream downloads.

datasets.name: OpenBible.info cross-references
datasets.origin: OpenBible.info file dated 2024-11-04 via scrollmapper/bible_databases (pinned in pipeline/sources.lock.json). The wheel shows every Old/New Testament link with 3 or more votes; the build checks this.

datasets.name: STEPBible Data (TAHOT, TAGNT, TBESH, TBESG)
datasets.attribution: Hebrew and Greek words, their meaning in each verse, and short dictionary meanings from STEP Bible (www.stepbible.org), CC BY 4.0
datasets.origin: STEPBible/STEPBible-Data at commit 5de0a47 (pinned with sha256 in pipeline/sources.lock.json)

datasets.name: Dodson Greek-English Lexicon
datasets.attribution: Plain-English Greek definitions from the Dodson Greek-English Lexicon (John Jeffrey Dodson), dedicated to the public domain under CC0.

datasets.name: King James Version (1769)
datasets.origin: v16 snapshot; two KJV editions merged, see docs/DATA.md

datasets.name: Berean Standard Bible
datasets.attribution: Berean Standard Bible (BSB), dedicated to the public domain under CC0.

datasets.name: Telugu Indian Revised Version (IRV) 2019
datasets.attribution: The Indian Revised Version Holy Bible in the Telugu language of India, copyright © 2017, 2019 Bridge Connectivity Solutions Pvt. Ltd. Text from eBible.org. Changes: converted to plain text without notes or headings, and NRSV verse numbering mapped to KJV numbering (3 John 1:15 joined to 1:14; Revelation 12:18 joined to 13:1).
datasets.origin: eBible.org SWORD module telirv2019eb version 36.43 (2026-10-29), supplied by hand; pinned by sha256 in pipeline/sources.lock.json

datasets.name: Scripture Universe story, journeys, evidence, Evidence Centre and Q&A
datasets.licence: Own content; each item cites its own sources

datasets.name: Theographic Bible Metadata (people, places, events)
datasets.attribution: People, places and events from Theographic Bible Metadata by Robert Rouse, CC BY-SA 4.0. Changes: reduced to the fields the app uses and linked to its verse numbering.

datasets.name: OpenBible.info Bible Geocoding Data
datasets.attribution: Bible places, their verses and how confident scholars are about each location, from OpenBible.info Bible Geocoding Data (CC BY 4.0). Changes: reduced to each place’s best-supported location, other proposed locations and verse list, linked to the app’s verse numbering.

datasets.name: UBS Project MARBLE Bible Routes
datasets.attribution: Bible journey routes © United Bible Societies 2023, created for UBS Project MARBLE by Dr Leen Ritmeyer, CC BY-SA 4.0. Changes: lines simplified and grouped by period of the Bible story; titles taken from the file names. The routes pack is shared under the same licence.

datasets.name: Natural Earth (land, lakes, rivers)
datasets.attribution: Coastlines, lakes and rivers from Natural Earth (public domain), cut to the Bible world and simplified.
